notes: CORRECTION, not a new independent study. Replaces dragonflight-20261031-50044's missing output item ID only. Modern retail rank-3 output item ID 192851 is corroborated at https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/192851 (current retail catalogue); third-party tooltip/data is not an independent original cast sample nor in-game API confirmation. source.title: Khaz'gorite prospecting discussion, original Dragonflight era

notes: Named cross-site searches for source-level Dragonflight 0/1/2+ prospecting and milling logs. Reviewed Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite and Prismatic Ore, plus Bubble Poppy, Saxifrage, and Hochenblume. Available hits lead to previously recorded Bugy, Xenastro, Jallfo, ar_rules, superbondez, TheChisel, Aary, historical nominal-ore aggregates, third-party quality catalogs, or guide estimates—not a NEW independent source with per-output actual completed casts, material hit counts/zeros/positive-unit histogram and refund accounting. No casts inferred from nominal input; no invented zero, probability, or yield. GoldCap also corroborates Serevite rank mapping 190395=R1, 190396=R2, 190394=R3 and Eternity Amber 192849=R1,192850=R2,192851=R3, but is a single secondary catalog. Do not count copied cohorts as independent; revisit only with original SavedVariables/cast export.
